build_nerfdet_detector: build a nerfdet 3D detector model with backbone, neck, bbox_head, and NeRF MLP for lidar-to-image voxel backprojection
test_nerfdet_simple_test: test the nerfdet simple_test method to run 3D bounding box inference on input images with optional NeRF ray rendering
review_nerfdet_extract_feat: review the nerfdet extract_feat method that backprojects 2D image features into a 3D voxel volume and optionally renders NeRF rays
refactor_backproject_function: refactor the backproject function to project 3D voxel points onto 2D image features using camera projection matrices
summarize_get_extrinsics: summarize the get_extrinsics function that computes a 4x4 extrinsic camera matrix from yaw, pitch, and roll angles
